bib.title: Align before Fuse: Vision and Language Representation Learning with Momentum Distillation

question: Can aligning image and text representations with a contrastive loss before cross-modal fusion, plus momentum-distillation pseudo-targets, give a detector-free VLP model that does better on retrieval and reasoning tasks?
hypothesis: Aligning unimodal features before fusion makes cross-modal learning easier, and momentum-distilled pseudo-targets help learning from noisy web text.
contributions: ALBEF: image-text contrastive loss before fusion, no detector or box annotations
SOTA on retrieval, VQA, NLVR2, SNLI-VE, weakly-supervised grounding

method.summary: ViT-B/16 image encoder, 6-layer BERT text encoder and 6-layer cross-attention multimodal encoder pretrained with ITC + MLM + ITM (hard negatives from contrastive similarity) and momentum distillation (alpha 0.4), then fine-tuned on five downstream tasks.
method.task: vision-language pretraining; image-text retrieval, VQA, NLVR2, SNLI-VE, weakly-supervised grounding

datasets.name: Pretrain 4M set (CC3M, SBU, COCO, VG)
datasets.preprocessing: random crops 256x256, RandAugment without color changes

datasets.name: Conceptual 12M
datasets.size: 10.06M images/texts (Table 8); total 14.1M images with the 4M set

datasets.name: VQA2.0
datasets.size: 83k train, 41k val, 81k test images (train+val plus Visual Genome QA used for training)

datasets.name: RefCOCO+
datasets.preprocessing: val/test images seen in pretraining (not decontaminated)

models.name: ALBEF
models.architecture: ViT-B/16 (12 layers) image encoder; 6-layer text encoder; 6-layer multimodal encoder with cross-attention
models.init_from: ViT from DeiT ImageNet-1k weights; text encoder first 6 layers of BERTbase, multimodal encoder last 6 layers

training.objective: L = L_itc + L_mlm + L_itm, with MoD versions (alpha 0.4, ramped 0 to 0.4 in the first epoch); MLM mask 15%
training.lr: warm up to 1e-4 over first 1000 iterations, decay to 1e-5

other.finetune_NLVR2: 10 epochs, batch 128, lr 2e-5; TA pretraining 1 epoch, batch 256, lr 2e-5, 256x256

inference.decoding: VQA: autoregressive 6-layer decoder restricted to 3,192 candidate answers; retrieval: s_itc top-k then s_itm rerank
inference.retrieval: top-k by s_itc, k=128 in main ablation column (k=16/128/256 tested)

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.definition: TR/IR R@1, R@5, R@10; Table 1 reports mean of the three

metrics.name: Grounding acc
metrics.definition: Grad-CAM ranks detected proposals on RefCOCO+

eval.protocol: single reported numbers, no variance or seeds

availability.weights: models available at the same repo
